gloss: attributive form of copula (used with na-adjectives)

definitions.explanation: The attributive form of the copula だ, used to connect na-adjectives to nouns they modify. This is why these adjectives are called 'na-adjectives' ({形容動詞|けいようどうし}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧。
⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧な⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧。
{綺麗|きれい}な⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。

notes:
な is the attributive form of the copula だ, used to connect na-adjectives (⟦{形容動詞|けいようどうし}→形容動詞：31297_keiyoudoushi⟧) to the nouns they modify.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [na-adjective] + な + [noun]
- Example: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧ + な + ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ = a quiet room
- [noun] + な + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ / ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で / ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で (because I am a student), ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (even though it is Sunday)

CONTRAST WITH だ:
- だ is the predicative form (sentence-ending): ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だ (It's quiet)
- な is the attributive form (before nouns): ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ (quiet room)

NOTE: Do not confuse with:
- ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧ (name) - a noun
- な (sentence-ending particle for commands) - a different particle
